fields.label: D-11073 scope
fields.value: LOWER than the row says. Hold does NOT need the camera-path module: the exit test is an AND, the flag alone blocks it, and FUN_004102f0 sets the flag itself under DAT_005f29b8==100000 — a write already inside FUN_004111c0 at 0x004100d3. Clear comes from FUN_00445aa0. DAT_00657448 has NO writer in the image. Owed re-classify correction.
